exercises.title: Past Continuous — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci forma e significato del Past Continuous prima della pratica autonoma.
exercises.instructions: Impara a vedere un'azione in corso in un momento passato e costruiscila con was/were + -ing.

sections.title: Un'azione che era già in corso
sections.instructions: Prima riconosci il significato, poi controlla was/were e la forma in -ing.

questions.title: Past Continuous: fotografa un momento nel passato
questions.prompt: Prima di esercitarti
questions.instructions: Leggi la regola e osserva la scena.
questions.learning_objective: Use was/were + verb-ing for actions in progress at a past time and background actions.

content.body: Il Past Continuous descrive un'azione che era in corso in un momento passato. Si costruisce con was/were + verbo in -ing.
content.intro: Immagina una fotografia scattata ieri alle otto: che cosa stava succedendo proprio in quel momento?

sections.title: La struttura
sections.body: Scegli was o were dal soggetto e poi aggiungi il verbo in -ing.
sections.pattern: I/he/she/it + was + verb-ing · you/we/they + were + verb-ing

sections.title: Azione in corso in un momento passato
sections.body: Usalo quando vuoi mostrare che l'azione era già in svolgimento in quel momento.

examples.text: At 9 last night, Marco was driving home.
This time yesterday, we were taking the test.

sections.title: Lo sfondo di una scena
sections.body: Il Past Continuous può descrivere più azioni che formano lo sfondo di una scena passata.

examples.text: People were talking, music was playing and the rain was falling outside.

sections.title: Negativa
sections.pattern: subject + was not / were not + verb-ing

sections.title: Domanda
sections.body: Sposta was/were prima del soggetto. Non usare did.

sections.title: Non perdere l'ausiliare
sections.body: La forma in -ing da sola non basta.

correct.text: They were studying in the library.

sections.title: Da ricordare
points: Descrive un'azione in corso in un momento passato.
Può costruire lo sfondo di una scena.

questions.title: Costruisci la forma
questions.prompt: Completa la frase.
questions.learning_objective: Build an affirmative Past Continuous form with correct auxiliary and -ing form.

feedback.explanation: My sister = she → was; dopo was serve making.

questions.title: Che cosa comunica la frase?
questions.prompt: At midnight, I was still working on the project.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise an action in progress at a specific past time.

options.text: L'azione era in corso a mezzanotte.
L'azione è un'abitudine presente.
L'azione inizierà a mezzanotte.

feedback.explanation: Was working mostra l'azione già in svolgimento a mezzanotte.

questions.title: Sistema la negativa
questions.prompt: Correggi: We not sleeping at eleven.
questions.learning_objective: Form a negative Past Continuous sentence.

accepted_answers: We were not sleeping at eleven.

feedback.explanation: La negativa mantiene were: were not / weren't sleeping.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Continuous wh-question.

feedback.explanation: What + were + the students + doing?

questions.title: Una scena in movimento
questions.prompt: Yesterday at six, the café was busy: people were talking and a waiter was carrying drinks.
questions.instructions: Perché sono usati i Past Continuous?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise Past Continuous as background description.

options.text: Descrivono azioni in corso che formano lo sfondo della scena.
Elencano una sequenza di azioni future.
Descrivono abitudini quotidiane.

feedback.explanation: Le azioni erano in corso nello stesso momento e costruiscono la scena.

exercises.title: Past Continuous — Allenati
exercises.description: Recupera la forma senza spiegazione e usala in scene, messaggi e domande.
exercises.instructions: Lavora a memoria: soggetto → was/were → verbo in -ing.

sections.title: Recupera la forma nel contesto
sections.instructions: Le attività mescolano significato, forma e ordine delle parole.

questions.title: Una sera normale, vista alle nove
questions.prompt: Completa con il Past Continuous.
questions.learning_objective: Produce Past Continuous affirmative forms with different subjects.

content.text_template: At nine last night, I [[blank_1]] (study), my parents [[blank_2]] (watch) TV and my brother [[blank_3]] (have) a shower.

feedback.explanation: I/brother → was; parents → were; tutti i verbi restano in -ing.

questions.title: Trova i due problemi
questions.prompt: Correggi: They was wait outside at 8.
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement and missing -ing form.

accepted_answers: They were waiting outside at eight.

feedback.explanation: They → were; dopo were serve waiting.

questions.title: Una domanda al telefono
questions.prompt: Metti le parole nell'ordine corretto.
questions.learning_objective: Build a natural Past Continuous question.

feedback.explanation: Were + you + sleeping + at midnight?

questions.title: Quali scene sono costruite bene?
questions.prompt: Seleziona tutte le frasi corrette.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise complete Past Continuous structures.

options.text: The children were playing in the garden.
I was writing an email.
Sara were cooking dinner.
We were wait for the bus.

feedback.explanation: La forma completa è was/were + verbo in -ing con accordo corretto.

questions.title: Che cosa stavi facendo?
questions.prompt: Scegli la risposta più naturale.
questions.learning_objective: Use Past Continuous naturally to answer about an action in progress at a past time.

content.scenario: Two friends talk about last night.

turns.speaker: Leo
turns.text: I called you at about ten last night.

turns.speaker: Marta
turns.text: I saw the missed call later.

options.text: I was having a shower, so I didn't hear my phone.
I having a shower every night.
I did having a shower.

feedback.explanation: La domanda chiede cosa era in corso alle dieci: I was having a shower.

questions.title: Traduci la scena
questions.prompt: Alle sette ieri sera stavamo cenando.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a Past Continuous sentence from Italian.

accepted_answers: We were having dinner at seven yesterday evening.
We were having dinner at seven last night.
At seven yesterday evening, we were having dinner.
At seven last night, we were having dinner.

feedback.explanation: We → were + having; il riferimento temporale rende chiaro il momento passato.

questions.title: Negativa completa
questions.prompt: Completa la frase.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Continuous negative accurately.

content.text_template: The students [[blank_1]] [[blank_2]] attention during the video.

feedback.explanation: Students = they → weren't; poi paying.

questions.title: Lo sfondo della scena
questions.prompt: Which sentence best describes the background of a busy station at 6 p.m. yesterday?
questions.learning_objective: Select Past Continuous to describe background actions in a past scene.

options.text: People were rushing for trains and announcements were playing over the speakers.
People rush for trains every day.
People will rush for trains tomorrow.

feedback.explanation: La domanda chiede lo sfondo in un preciso momento passato: were rushing / were playing.

exercises.title: Past Continuous — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Affronta il Past Continuous in formati tipici di una verifica scolastica.
exercises.instructions: Completa tutto senza correzioni immediate. Il feedback arriva alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica scolastica
sections.instructions: Controlla significato, forma e ordine delle parole.

questions.title: Complete the sentences
questions.prompt: Put the verbs in brackets into the Past Continuous.
questions.learning_objective: Produce affirmative and negative Past Continuous forms in school-style gap fill.

content.text_template: 1. Mum [[blank_1]] (cook) at 7. 2. We [[blank_2]] (not/listen) to music. 3. The boys [[blank_3]] (run) in the park.

feedback.explanation: Controlla accordo was/were, negativa e forma in -ing.

questions.title: Correct the mistake
questions.prompt: Correct: Was they waiting outside?
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement in a Past Continuous question.

feedback.explanation: They richiede were: Were they waiting...?

questions.title: Make a question
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Continuous wh-question in school format.

feedback.explanation: Why + was + Luca + laughing?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Ieri alle dieci mia sorella stava studiando in camera sua.
questions.learning_objective: Translate a clear action-in-progress context into Past Continuous.

accepted_answers: Yesterday at ten, my sister was studying in her room.
My sister was studying in her room at ten yesterday.

feedback.explanation: Il momento passato è preciso e l'azione era in corso: was studying.

questions.title: Choose the correct sentence
questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a fully correct Past Continuous sentence.

options.text: The teacher was speaking to another student.
The teacher were speaking to another student.
The teacher was speak to another student.
The teacher speaking to another student.

feedback.explanation: Teacher = he/she → was + speaking.

questions.title: Complete the exchange
questions.prompt: Complete the short exchange.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate Past Continuous question and answer forms.

content.text_template: A: What [[blank_1]] you doing at 9? B: I [[blank_2]] studying for the test.

feedback.explanation: You → were nella domanda; I → was nella risposta.

exercises.title: Past Continuous — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su significato, struttura, domande, negative e uso descrittivo del Past Continuous.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva solo alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Leggi il contesto prima di scegliere la forma.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: At 11 last night, the lights were on and Anna was still working at her desk.
questions.learning_objective: Interpret Past Continuous as an action in progress at a past time.

options.text: The action was in progress at 11.
It was Anna's daily habit.
The action will happen later.

feedback.explanation: Was working presenta l'azione come già in corso alle undici.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.prompt: Complete the scene with the Past Continuous.
questions.learning_objective: Produce several Past Continuous background actions in one connected scene.

content.text_template: At six yesterday evening, people [[blank_1]] (leave) the offices, buses [[blank_2]] (move) slowly through traffic and it [[blank_3]] (rain).

feedback.explanation: Le tre azioni formano lo sfondo della scena alle sei.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: My friends was waiting for me outside.
questions.learning_objective: Correct was/were agreement independently.

accepted_answers: My friends were waiting for me outside.

feedback.explanation: Friends = they → were waiting.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Continuous information question independently.

feedback.explanation: Where + were + your parents + going?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.prompt: Non stavamo usando il computer alle dieci.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a negative Past Continuous sentence from Italian.

accepted_answers: We weren't using the computer at ten.
We were not using the computer at ten.

feedback.explanation: We → were not / weren't + using.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Select all grammatically correct sentences.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate correct Past Continuous structures across subjects and polarity.

options.text: I was waiting near the entrance.
They weren't paying attention.
Was you sleeping?
She was write a message.

feedback.explanation: Controlla was/were e la forma in -ing in ogni frase.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Choose the most natural reply.
questions.learning_objective: Respond naturally to a Past Continuous question in context.

content.scenario: A student explains why she missed a call.

turns.speaker: Tom
turns.text: I tried to call you around eight.

options.text: I was helping my brother with his homework.
I helping my brother.
I did helping my brother.

feedback.explanation: La risposta descrive ciò che era in corso alle otto: I was helping...

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Complete the question and answer.
questions.learning_objective: Coordinate auxiliary agreement, question structure and affirmative response.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] Mia and Sara studying at 6? B: No, they [[blank_2]] travelling home.

feedback.explanation: Mia and Sara = they → were sia nella domanda sia nella risposta.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Correct: Did Luca working at 5 yesterday?
questions.learning_objective: Replace an incorrect did-question with correct Past Continuous inversion.

accepted_answers: Was Luca working at five yesterday?

feedback.explanation: Nel Past Continuous non usi did: Was Luca working...?

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Yesterday at 4 p.m. you looked into the school library. Which description best gives the scene as it was happening?
questions.learning_objective: Choose Past Continuous to build a coherent background scene.

options.text: Some students were reading, two people were working on laptops and the librarian was helping a boy.
Some students read books every afternoon and the librarian helps them.
Some students will read and the librarian will help them.

feedback.explanation: La richiesta è una fotografia della scena alle quattro: azioni in corso sullo sfondo.

questions.title: Item 11
questions.prompt: Che cosa stavano facendo i tuoi amici alle nove? Non stavano studiando.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a Past Continuous question and negative answer in one controlled task.

accepted_answers: What were your friends doing at nine? They weren't studying.
What were your friends doing at nine? They were not studying.

feedback.explanation: Domanda: What were your friends doing...? Negativa: They weren't studying.
